objective: Design one coherent visual micro-event that grounds the accepted L000 thesis before drills, image prompts, or runtime script.
story_acceptance_rules: Use one persistent natural interaction, goal, or uncertainty with a meaningful resolution; an abstract name-board or label-sorting worksheet is not a story.
Use the now-registered canonical Taro reference when Taro appears; ground a name to the depicted recurring participant, not merely to a text card.
Prefer Ninereeds as the responding participant so every scored first-person answer remains Ninereeds.
The story need not contain every L000 form or every source name. Coherence outranks coverage; the overall lesson, not this one story, covers the whole frontier.
Score only world claims actually grounded by the story and inside the accepted thesis. Interface constraints remain visual-safety metadata.
Comprehension must depend on the event. Nonverbal selection uses the machine control SELECT_VISUAL and expected option IDs, never an untaught spoken instruction.
No scored quoted-character completion and no expected first-person answer as Taro, Emma, Bob, or Errol.
The book is noncanonical instructional material and creates no first meeting, biography, ontology, or chronology update.
required_output: One closed JSON object following the story template and copying required_input_bindings exactly into input_bindings.
forbidden_work: write practice pools or generation prompts
read failed drafts or story outputs
decision_rule: Pass only if the event is coherent, visually grounded, identity-safe, within the world objective, and validation passes. Otherwise alarm.
